armyRules.name: Fenrisian Fury
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Wolves fight with their whole bodies and are not good at waiting. A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Attacks on the turn it charges, but at the start of its Assault phase it must declare a Charge against the nearest enemy unit within 8" if it is able to.

armyRules.name: Saga-Bound
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A Space Wolves lord has sworn his boasts before the hall and cannot take them back. A Character with this rule adds 1 to its Attacks while in a Challenge and may never decline one, and when it is slain, every friendly Space Wolves unit within 12" must make a Cool Check at -1.

armyRules.name: Keen Senses
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Fenrisian hunters smell an ambush before it is sprung. A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Intelligence and enemy units may not use Infiltrate or Outflank to arrive within 12" of it, but the unit subtracts 1 from its Leadership.

wargear.name: Wolf-skull totem
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A pole hung with the skulls of beasts the pack has run down, and the teeth of a few men. Enemies learn to dread the sight of it. Every model in the unit gains Fear (1).

wargear.name: Wolf-pelt mantle
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A heavy cloak cut from a Fenrisian beast the bearer killed alone. The model gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Skald's saga-horn
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A great horn from which a skald sounds the deeds of the pack so that no brother fights unremembered. Gives the model Rousing Saga.

wargear.name: Jarl's drinking horn
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A horn of Fenrisian mead that must be drained before battle. Gives the model Mead of Heroes.

wargear.name: Fang-talisman
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A rune-carved fang worn by Rune Priests against the Warp. Gives the model Rune-Ward.

wargear.name: Chain-snares
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Weighted chains thrown to bind the legs of prey. Gives the model Snare-Chains.

wargear.name: Rune-sight
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A rune-etched targeter fitted to a hunter's helm. Gives the model Predator's Eye.

wargear.name: Bone-trophy racks
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Skulls and tusks lashed to a hull until it looks like a hunting lodge on tracks. Gives the vehicle Skull-Strewn Hull.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a Fenrisian weapon
Up to five Legionaries may exchange their chainsword for
Up to three Hunters may take a Hunter's longbolter
The unit may carry a Wolf-skull totem
Trophies of the saga: may take up to two
The Sergeant may take a Rune-sight
Up to one Hunter may take a Whale-spear launcher
Up to two Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
The Sergeant may take a Bonebreaker maul

modifiers.text: Grey Slayers fight as hunters, not marksmen: +1 S, -1 BS.
Jorlund hunters, lean and patient: +1 BS, -1 T.
Sons of Fenris, proud and unruly: +1 I, -1 LD.
Rune-singers trade the blade for the storm: +1 WP, -1 WS.
Wolf Guard hold the hall-floor like oaks: +1 WS, -1 I.
The Death Wolf walks beside them: 5+ Invulnerable Save, -1 I.
Jarl's drinking horn: Mead of Heroes.

rules.name: Run Down the Prey
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Long Hunt). The pack strikes when the herd is already moving. A unit with this rule that enters play from Reserves counts any Charge roll of less than 6 as a 6 on that turn.

rules.name: Oathsworn Hearthguard
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Hall of the Wolf Guard). The Jarl's hearth-companions do not give ground. A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool Checks and cannot be Pinned.

rules.name: Blood-Howl
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Wolf Within). When the pack is half gone the beast takes over. Once a unit with this rule has lost half or more of its starting models, it gains Feel No Pain (6+) and automatically passes Cool Checks.

rules.name: Thunder of the Wild Ride
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Wild Ride). A unit with this rule that Rushes may still declare a Charge on that turn, at -2" to the distance rolled.

rules.name: Rousing Saga
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Friendly Space Wolves units within 12" of the bearer add 1 to their Cool Checks.

rules.name: Mead of Heroes
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of a Combat, the bearer's unit adds 1 to its Attacks until the end of that turn.

rules.name: Rune-Ward
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Psychic Checks that target the bearer's unit subtract 1 from the result.

rules.name: Snare-Chains
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy models Locked in Combat with the bearer subtract 1 from their Initiative.

rules.name: Predator's Eye
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The bearer adds 1 to its Hit Tests against units that Rushed in their last turn.

rules.name: Skull-Strewn Hull
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The vehicle gains Fear (1).

rites.name: The Long Hunt
rites.flavor: A wolf-pack does not charge the herd. It follows, and it waits, and it picks the moment.
benefits: Jorlund Hunter Packs may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Hunter Packs, Reconnaissance Squads and Scout Squads gain Outflank and Run Down the Prey: a unit that arrives from Reserves counts any Charge roll of less than 6 as a 6 on that turn.
limitations: At least one Jorlund Hunter Pack is required.
At least one unit with Run Down the Prey must start the battle in Reserves.
No Armour units and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: The Long Hunt: Run Down the Prey, Outflank.

require.note: Bring at least one Jorlund Hunter Pack.

rites.name: Hall of the Wolf Guard
rites.flavor: When the Jarl's hearth-companions march, no one else needs to stand in the line.
benefits: Varagyr Wolf Guard Terminators may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Varagyr gain Oathsworn Hearthguard: they add +1 to Cool Checks and cannot be Pinned.
limitations: At least one Varagyr pack is required.
No Transport units and no Fast Attack units.

modifiers.text: Hall of the Wolf Guard: Line (1), Oathsworn Hearthguard.

require.note: Bring at least one Varagyr pack.

rites.name: The Wolf Within
rites.flavor: Some packs go quiet when the moon rises. Their Wolf Lords stop counting how many come home.
benefits: Deathsworn Packs may fill Troops slots.
Grey Slayer Packs and Deathsworn Packs gain Blood-Howl: once the unit is at half strength or less it gains Feel No Pain (6+) and cannot fail Cool Checks.
They also gain +1 Attack on a turn they charge.
limitations: Grey Slayer and Deathsworn Packs have Heedless and cannot claim Objectives.
At least one Grey Slayer Pack is required.
No Casters of Runes of any kind, and no Heavy Support, Tactical Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

require.note: Bring at least one Grey Slayer Pack.

rites.name: The Wild Ride
rites.flavor: On Fenris the great beasts were ridden before the Legion ever knew a word for armour.
benefits: Outrider Squadrons and Attack Bike Squadrons may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Fast (1).
They gain Thunder of the Wild Ride: after Rushing they may still declare a Charge, at -2" to the distance rolled.
limitations: At least two Outrider Squadrons are required.
No Heavy Assault, Armour or Heavy Transport units.

modifiers.text: The Wild Ride: Line (1), Fast (1), Thunder of the Wild Ride.

require.note: Bring at least two Outrider Squadrons.
